ticket_id.description: the ticket's own identifier, the number printed as its id (azonosító)

holder_name.description: the name of the person the ticket is issued to (név)

event_name.description: the event the ticket admits to, as printed: the match's two teams with the dash between them, or the concert's title (mérkőzés, meccs, párharc, párosítás)

event_datetime.description: the event's date and starting time, written as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (időpont, dátum és idő)

venue.description: the name of the stadium, arena or hall where the event is held, as printed (helyszín); not its address

birth_place.description: the ticket holder's place of birth (születési hely)

birth_date.description: the ticket holder's date of birth (születési idő)

card_number.description: the number of the holder's club or fan card printed on the ticket (kártyaszám)

gate.description: the entrance gate exactly as printed in the ticket's gate field (Kapu/Gate), with every word and gate number of that field, not only its first part

sector.description: the sector as printed in the ticket's sector field (Szektor/Sector), with its mark and the word that follows the mark

row.description: the row number within the sector (Sor/Row)

seat.description: the seat number within the row (Szék/Seat)
